name: Proofpoint - Multiple users receiving the same high-risk email
xql_query:
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw 
| filter _log_type = "message-blocked"
| filter classification = "PHISHING"
| comp count_distinct(recipient) as target_count,
        values(recipient) as all_recipients
        by senderIP, campaignId, subject
| filter target_count >= 4
description: The same phishing email (same sender IP, campaign and subject) was blocked for 4+ distinct recipients - a coordinated phishing campaign against multiple users.
alert_name: Proofpoint - Multiple users receiving the same high-risk email
alert_description:
What fired: a single phishing campaign (same sender IP + campaign + subject) targeted >=4 distinct recipients.

Why it matters: coordinated multi-user targeting indicates an active campaign; other users may have received a DELIVERED (not blocked) copy.

Investigate:
  - Review the mapped sender IP, subject, campaign and the recipient list on this alert.
  - Confirm none of the targeted users received a delivered copy or clicked.
  - Consider blocking the sender/campaign.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1566 - Phishing (TA0001 - Initial Access).
